body:
RECOMMENDATION: approve the two-stage seam and implement ephemeral local inspection first. It proves the load-bearing source-plus-artifact identity join without silently creating a new persisted copy of story or recall text. Default inspect should bind only to loopback, choose an ephemeral port, terminate with the command, emit no analytics/network requests, and have a deterministic textual twin so QA is not screenshot-only. A later explicit export-html command can enter the receipted payload-manifest contract and warn that it embeds displayed text.

For ergonomics, expose the common journey as surface analyze PATH-or-dash and surface inspect SOURCE ARTIFACT; keep strict UTF-8, checksum mismatch, and UTF-16 coordinate details in concise structured failures rather than making users understand the codec internals. WOG is the ideal persisted public example; Sherlock source bytes and any participant text remain local-only by default. This preserves the direct path toward movie-recall inspection without conflating standoff analysis with custody-bearing publication. No scope/source mutation.
